Name: Assassins Creed Shadows
Description: Assassin's Creed Shadows is an action role-playing game set in 16th-century feudal Japan during the Sengoku period.

Name: Horizon Zero Dawn
Description: Horizon Zero Dawn is an action role-playing game developed by Guerrilla Games and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment.

Name: Lords of the Fallen
Description: Lords of the Fallen is a dark fantasy action RPG set in a vast interconnected world. Players take on the role of a Dark Crusader and embark on an epic quest to defeat the demon God Adyr.

Name: Grand Theft Auto VI
Description: Grand Theft Auto VI follows Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos as they become caught in a criminal conspiracy across the state of Leonida. The game returns players to the neon-filled streets of Vice City in the next major entry in the Grand Theft Auto series.

Name: Mortal Kombat 1
Description: Mortal Kombat 1 introduces a reborn Mortal Kombat Universe created by Fire God Liu Kang. It features a new fighting system, new game modes, iconic characters, and the series' famous Fatalities.

Name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla
Description: Assassin's Creed Valhalla is an action RPG set during the Viking invasion of England. Players take the role of Eivor, a Viking warrior who leads their clan from Norway to England while building a new settlement and battling rival kingdoms.

Name: Tekken 8
Description: Tekken 8 is a 3D fighting game that continues the story of the Mishima family. The game features an expanded roster of fighters, intense combat, new gameplay mechanics, and the powerful Unreal Engine 5.

Name: Resident Evil Requiem
Description: Resident Evil Requiem is a survival horror game that follows FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft as she investigates mysterious deaths connected to the Raccoon City incident. The game combines intense horror, exploration, combat, and a cinematic single-player experience.

Name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
Description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is an open-world role-playing game following Geralt of Rivia as he searches for his adopted daughter across a war-torn fantasy world.

Name: Red Dead Redemption 2
Description: Red Dead Redemption 2 is an open-world adventure set in the American frontier, following outlaw Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang.

Name: Grand Theft Auto V
Description: Grand Theft Auto V is an action-adventure game following three criminals whose lives become connected through a series of dangerous heists in Los Santos.

Name: Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered
Description: Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered follows Peter Parker as he protects New York City while facing powerful enemies and personal challenges.

Name: God of War
Description: God of War follows Kratos and his son Atreus as they journey through the dangerous realms of Norse mythology.

Name: Elden Ring
Description: Elden Ring is an open-world action role-playing game set in the mysterious Lands Between, where players explore, fight powerful enemies, and uncover a vast fantasy story.

Name: Cyberpunk 2077
Description: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world role-playing game set in Night City, where mercenary V becomes involved in a dangerous struggle for power and survival.

Name: Hogwarts Legacy
Description: Hogwarts Legacy is an open-world adventure set in the Wizarding World where players attend Hogwarts, learn magic, explore mysterious locations, and battle dangerous enemies.

Name: The Last of Us Part I
Description: The Last of Us Part I follows Joel and Ellie as they travel across a post-apocalyptic United States filled with infected creatures and hostile survivors.

Name: Resident Evil 4
Description: Resident Evil 4 is a survival horror game following Leon S. Kennedy as he searches for the kidnapped daughter of the United States president in a remote European village.

Name: Devil May Cry 5
Description: Devil May Cry 5 is a fast-paced action game where Nero, Dante, and V battle demonic forces using powerful weapons and supernatural abilities.

Name: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
Description: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice is an action game set in a fictionalized version of Sengoku-era Japan, following a shinobi seeking revenge against his enemies.

Name: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth
Description: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth follows Cloud Strife and his companions as they leave Midgar and pursue Sephiroth across a vast and dangerous world.

Name: Baldur's Gate 3
Description: Baldur's Gate 3 is a party-based role-playing game where players explore the Forgotten Realms, make meaningful choices, and battle enemies through turn-based combat.

Name: Monster Hunter World
Description: Monster Hunter World allows players to hunt massive creatures, gather materials, craft powerful equipment, and explore a living ecosystem.

Name: Diablo IV
Description: Diablo IV is an action role-playing game set in the dark world of Sanctuary, where players battle demons and powerful enemies while developing their character.

Name: Forza Horizon 5
Description: Forza Horizon 5 is an open-world racing game set in Mexico featuring hundreds of cars, dynamic weather, races, events, and exploration.

Name: Gran Turismo 7
Description: Gran Turismo 7 is a realistic racing simulator featuring a large collection of cars, detailed tracks, championships, and competitive racing.

Name: F1 23
Description: F1 23 is an official Formula 1 racing game featuring real teams, drivers, circuits, competitive multiplayer, and a cinematic career mode.

Name: Need for Speed Unbound
Description: Need for Speed Unbound is an arcade racing game where players compete in street races, customize cars, and escape intense police pursuits.

Name: Dirt 5
Description: Dirt 5 is an off-road racing game featuring rally cars, extreme environments, dynamic tracks, and competitive racing events.

Name: Mortal Kombat 11
Description: Mortal Kombat 11 is a fighting game featuring iconic characters, brutal combat, cinematic story sequences, and the series' famous Fatalities.

Name: Street Fighter 6
Description: Street Fighter 6 is a fighting game featuring classic fighters, new characters, multiple gameplay modes, and a modern combat system.

Name: Dragon Ball FighterZ
Description: Dragon Ball FighterZ is a fast-paced 2D fighting game featuring characters from the Dragon Ball universe and intense three-versus-three battles.

Name: EA Sports UFC 5
Description: EA Sports UFC 5 is a mixed martial arts fighting game featuring realistic fighters, grappling, striking, career progression, and online competition.

Name: Soulcalibur VI
Description: Soulcalibur VI is a weapon-based fighting game featuring legendary warriors, strategic combat, character creation, and multiple story modes.

Name: Outlast 2
Description: Outlast 2 is a psychological survival horror game following journalist Blake Langermann as he investigates a mysterious disappearance in a remote village.

Name: Dead Space
Description: Dead Space is a survival horror game following engineer Isaac Clarke as he explores a damaged spacecraft filled with terrifying mutated creatures.

Name: Silent Hill 2
Description: Silent Hill 2 is a psychological survival horror game following James Sunderland as he searches for his deceased wife in the mysterious town of Silent Hill.

Name: Amnesia: The Bunker
Description: Amnesia: The Bunker is a first-person survival horror game set in a World War I bunker where players must survive while being hunted by a mysterious creature.

Name: Alan Wake 2
Description: Alan Wake 2 is a psychological survival horror game following FBI agent Saga Anderson and writer Alan Wake as their stories become mysteriously connected.

Name: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End
Description: Uncharted 4 follows Nathan Drake as he returns to the world of treasure hunting for one final adventure involving pirates, lost treasure, and dangerous rivals.

Name: Shadow of the Tomb Raider
Description: Shadow of the Tomb Raider follows Lara Croft as she travels through ancient ruins and dangerous environments while trying to prevent a catastrophic event.

Name: Ghost of Tsushima
Description: Ghost of Tsushima follows samurai warrior Jin Sakai as he fights to defend Tsushima Island from the Mongol invasion while embracing new combat techniques.

Name: Uncharted: The Lost Legacy
Description: Uncharted: The Lost Legacy follows Chloe Frazer and Nadine Ross as they search for an ancient Indian artifact while facing dangerous enemies.

Name: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown
Description: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown is an action-adventure platformer following Sargon as he explores a mysterious cursed world and battles powerful enemies.

Name: Far Cry 6
Description: Far Cry 6 is an open-world action game set on the fictional island of Yara, where players join a guerrilla revolution against a powerful dictator.

Name: Dying Light 2
Description: Dying Light 2 is an open-world action game set in a post-apocalyptic city overrun by infected creatures, featuring parkour, combat, and player choices.

Name: DOOM Eternal
Description: DOOM Eternal is a fast-paced first-person action shooter where the Doom Slayer battles hordes of demons across Earth and other dimensions.

Name: Death Stranding
Description: Death Stranding is an adventure game following Sam Porter Bridges as he travels across a fractured United States, reconnecting isolated communities in a mysterious post-apocalyptic world.
